evidence.correctedFrom: earlier value "NovaCart ledger refunds $200 vs PayPal refunded $0 → divergence $200" was wrong: real PayPal omits the amount in the create-refund response; recomputed from GET /v2/payments/refunds/5KP7598866884964C
evidence.insight: PayPal's capture cap stops the platform payout, but NovaCart's own refund logic would still approve and book the extra amount. The defence must live in NovaCart's refund code (refund-calc / refund-idempotency), not only at PayPal.
